auth_type.title: Authentication Type
auth_type.description: How to authenticate to Snowflake. Snowflake is phasing out password authentication for service accounts, so Key Pair is recommended for automated jobs.

account.title: Account
account.description:
Account identifier of the Snowflake instance. This is a prefix of your Snowflake instance URL, e.g. keboola.eu-central-1.
See the documentation for more information.

username.title: Username
username.description: Snowflake user, which will be used to run queries.

#password.title: Password
#password.description: A password authenticating the Snowflake user.

#private_key.title: Private Key
#private_key.description: PEM-formatted RSA private key (PKCS#8) for key-pair (JWT) authentication. The matching public key must be assigned to the user with ALTER USER ... SET RSA_PUBLIC_KEY. See the key-pair authentication documentation.

#private_key_passphrase.title: Private Key Passphrase
#private_key_passphrase.description: Optional passphrase if the private key is encrypted. Leave empty for an unencrypted key.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Name of the Snowflake warehouse to be used.
